purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only min/max limits on one caller-selected world-space x or y relative offset while preserving slack motion inside the interval and free orthogonal translation, with explicit standalone and shared one-step composer paths.

properties.limits: bounded explicit x/y world-axis limits with minOffset and/or maxOffset
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: slack motion inside the allowed interval is intentionally free
axis does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
the standalone wrapper still performs its own donor-core step; callers needing mixed families must use the shared composer/activity/isolation path rather than chaining wrappers
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

proves: slack motion inside the allowed interval
axis limits participate in the shared composer without a second donor-core step
slack axis-limit edges can join explicit isolation topology without becoming physical locks
disabled axis limits remain validated evidence but are excluded from guarded solve and topology
orthogonal freedom and same-runtime deterministic replay survive shared-stack integration

truth.basis: The capability is explicitly a translation-only world-axis range primitive and is not relabeled as a full prismatic joint; slack physical semantics are separated from optional isolation topology.

agency.basis: Callers choose axis, min/max bounds, activity state, isolation use and bounded solver factors/iterations.

continuity.basis: The donor core and standalone primitive remain intact while the established shared composer consumes the same primitive additively.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Mixed-family use goes through the tested single-integration composer instead of chaining wrappers and accidentally advancing donor physics twice.
